description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper for the Kitchen Stories recipe website. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract recipe data such as name, ingredients, instructions, images, and timing information. The scraper is encapsulated in an asynchronous function that returns a Promise.

methods.name: kitchenStories
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, validates it, fetches the webpage, parses the HTML to extract recipe details, and returns a Promise resolving to a Recipe object.
